ops.title: Pre-existing-issue nudge misfires are thinking-block deliberation (D11 sample, release-v3 sweep)
ops.body:
Sample: 8 of 50 logged injections of the steering pre-existing-issue nudge in release-v3 session 900424b6 (sidechains, picked every ~6th row). 7 of 8 were misfires; 1 justified (deploy-experience #2664: "pre-existing bug in deploy-go, not caused by my change, so I should report it upstream rather than fix it").

Every sampled fire scored on a thinking block, never visible prose. Attribution by NLP clause:
- "change did not cause/introduce" clause alone: d1-remnants #207, sandsql-handoff-fix #867 (both misfires). Fixed in PR #237 by weighting that clause 1, so it needs "pre-existing" or "out of scope" alongside.
- "leave the issue" clause in thinking: 1e171725361e48f9 #371 ("would leave the verb words undetected"), cc-slack-grant-gate-2 #2005, incident-retro-phase4 #266, localdev-no-ssm #200, paging-monitor-sweep #446. Not fixed: the same clause backs justified prose tests ("I'll leave that issue alone for now"), so a threshold raise or event narrowing would drop them.

Remaining fix needs a Signals knob to score prose without thinking blocks, which needs a field on cc-transcript's snapshot `signal_texts` query (native) plus captain_hook.signals.transcript_texts. Scripts and outputs: ~/.claude/scratch/release-v3/hooks-sweep/builtin-precision/d11_*.
